summary: bloom là ứng dụng desktop tùy chỉnh cho Windows, mang lại trải nghiệm giao diện tự nhiên, mượt mà và tương tác linh hoạt.
usecases: Enhancing user productivity with a customizable desktop companion interface.
Serving as a dynamic dashboard for system metrics or notifications.
Providing an interactive personal assistant experience on Windows desktops.
ideas: Integrate with Tauri plugins for deep system access (e.g., file management, clipboard).
Build theming/skins support for visual personalization.
Combine with AI assistants for context-aware actions on the desktop.
